title: Constructing the characteristic fan map from normalized ordinary stalk charts
statement: Let $(X,M)$ be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme, let $Q$ be a fine saturated commutative monoid, and let $c:Q\to M(X)$ be a homomorphism [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Let $Z$ be a Zariski log structure on $X$, $e:Z\to M$ a structural natural family, and $z:Q\to Z(X)$ a Zariski chart with $e_Xz=c$ [def-trf-zariski-log-structure]. Put $E_x=\{q:\alpha_M(c(q))_x\in\mathcal O_{X,x}^{\times}\}$, and let $C_Z$ be the characteristic monoidal space with its actual quotient section map [lem-trf-chart-characteristic-stalk-comparison]. Assume given equivalences $a_x:(C_Z)_x\simeq\operatorname{Associates}(Q_{E_x})$ that send the characteristic germ of $z(q)$ to the class of the actual numerator $q/1$, for every $x,q$. Then there exists a sheafed-space morphism $f:C_Z\to S(Q)$ [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] such that $q\in f(x)$ if and only if $q\notin E_x$, each actual stalk map $f_x^{\#}$ is bijective, and $f_x^{\#}$ sends the canonical affine numerator germ of $q$ to the characteristic germ of $z(q)$. No geometric characteristic comparison or choice of a new log structure is part of this conclusion.

source.place: ILO VIII 3.1.1--3.1.8 and 3.3.2--3.3.4(ii), 3.3.12; original node Steps 4 and 5: continuity, gluing on basic opens, and identification of the actual stalk maps. Agent-expanded proof.

proof.text: The inverse image of ring units is a face, so its complement is a proper prime, including the empty prime. The inverse image of D(q) is the open unit locus of the structural chart function: inverse germs extend after shrinking. This constructs the continuous point map.

On that unit locus the characteristic section of q is one, so the chart homomorphism extends across inversion of q. Characteristic sections are sharp because a unit has unit germs, which are one, and sheaf uniqueness identifies the section with one. Thus the localization map kills units. Apply [lem-trf-affine-fan-localization-sections] to regard it as a map on the sharp affine sections of D(q). On overlaps both maps have the same numerator values; localization and quotient universality give equality on all fractions. Gluing over the basis yields f and the numerator stalk equation.

At each x the affine localization equivalence identifies the source stalk with Associates(Q_E). The supplied normalized a_x identifies the target with the same monoid. Every fraction is generated by numerators and inverses of face elements, so the numerator equation makes the stalk map the identity under these equivalences. It is therefore bijective.

lean.statement: theorem chart_characteristic_fan_map (X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) (Q : Type u) [CommMonoid Q] (hQ : IsFineSaturatedMonoid Q) (c : Q →* X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (⊤ : X.scheme.Opens).ι))) (Z : ZariskiLogStructure X.scheme) (e : Z.toZariskiPrelogStructure.EtaleMap X.logStructure) (z : Q →* Z.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op ⊤)) (hz : Z.IsChart ⊤ z) (he : (e.sectionMap ⊤).comp z = c) (a : ∀ x : X.scheme, FineFan.stalk Z.characteristicMonoidalSpace.presheaf x ≃* Associates (Algebra.faceLocalization Q (X.logStructure.globalChartUnitFace c x))) (ha : ∀ (x : X.scheme) (q : Q), ∃ r : Algebra.faceLocalization Q (X.logStructure.globalChartUnitFace c x), r.val = Algebra.GrothendieckGroup.of q ∧ a x (FineFan.germ Z.characteristicMonoidalSpace.presheaf ⊤ x (by trivial) (Z.characteristicSection ⊤ (z q))) = Associates.mk r) : ∃ f : Z.characteristicMonoidalSpace ⟶ FineFan.affine Q, (∀ (x : X.scheme) (q : Q), q ∈ (f.hom.base x).carrier ↔ q ∉ X.logStructure.globalChartUnitFace c x) ∧ (∀ x : X.scheme, Function.Bijective (FineFan.stalkMap f x)) ∧ (∀ (x : X.scheme) (q : Q), FineFan.stalkMap f x (FineFan.affineGerm (f.hom.base x) q) = FineFan.germ Z.characteristicMonoidalSpace.presheaf ⊤ x (by trivial) (Z.characteristicSection ⊤ (z q)))
